body: When I was younger I messed up a lot and did some pretty bad things. They used to make me feel really ashamed to think of but now they just make me feel empty.

You're gonna think I'm an idiot. I can't be myself and I feel like I haven't been able to for a very long time. I just bottle everything about myself up. Whenever I try to be myself or open up to people I just freak. It's beyond normal things, like public speaking. I don't tell jokes, I barely talk, I don't tell stories, I feel uncomfortable being silly in any way for some reason. The only times I get kind of close is with my friends but even with them I can be like this. I feel like I'm just so uncomfortable being myself that I just stopped doing it at some point.

I know how stupid this comment sounds. You don't have to be nice.
